articles.title: Raphinha cashes in against Santander with hat-trick as Barça hit seven
articles.summary: Cancelo, Jesus and Lamine Yamal also score in rout. Atlético Madrid thrash Osasuna 4-0 to move into third. Raphinha scored a hat-trick as Barcelona ripped Racing Santander to shreds in a spectacular 7-2 triumph in La Liga on Wednesday.
body: João Cancelo, Gabriel Jesus and Lamine Yamal also scored for the unstoppable Catalan giants, who have netted 33 goals in those seven games across all competitions, and who move three points clear of Real Madrid at the top of La Liga.

With lightning flashing above Camp Nou, Barca started at rapid pace and took the lead with a thunderbolt from Cancelo. The defender crashed a shot in off the crossbar from long range in the eighth minute.

Dani Olmo twice came close before Raphinha won and converted a penalty for Barça’s second. The Brazilian was clumsily brought down by Pedro Felipe and thrashed the spot-kick into the bottom right corner.

Santander pulled one back when Maguette Gueye barged his way through and produced a neat finish to beat goalkeeper Joan García. However it proved only brief respite, with Cancelo provoking the third with another long-range effort which deflected in off Asier Villalibre.

articles.title: De Cuyper and Brighton pile on pain for Manchester United with comeback
articles.summary: Across four days Manchester United have lost the 199th derby to Manchester City, were told by JJ Gabriel he wants to leave, and have now been knocked out of the Carabao Cup by Brighton.
body: Capitulating after being 2-0 up may be the pick of these dizzying blows, and when Marcus Rashford skated in with the chance to take the tie to 3-3 late on, there was no surprise he hit Jason Steele rather than the net.

Towards the end, Matheus Cunha was thrown on to join Bruno Fernandes, also a late substitute, illustrating how desperate Michael Carrick was. Yet Charalampos Kostoulas went close to scoring a second for Brighton, as United could not find a route to cancelling out Maxim De Cuyper’s 69th-minute strike that proved the winner.

After taking only four points from twelve in the league, serious questions will now be asked about where Carrick’s team are heading; they have to beat Fulham on Sunday to start correcting a dismal start to the season.
Carrick stated Sunday’s injustice against City would give his side an edge and Shea Lacey provided a cutting one when decorating a full debut with the sweetest of goals.

articles.title: Painful endgame for Gray as stale Hibs slump
articles.summary: A club hero, David Gray ends his time as Hibs head coach not to the sound of euphoria from fans, but to the sound of a support collectively exhaling in relief, writes Tom English.
body: It was the strangest kind of farewell; more sadness than satisfaction, more 'thanks for the memories' than 'never darken our door again'.

After a dozen years as a player, a goalscoring and Scottish Cup-winning icon, a coach, an interim manager and, for the last two-and-a-bit seasons, the first team manager, David Gray exited Hibernian on Wednesday evening.

He left, not to the sound of euphoria from the fans, but to the sound of a support collectively exhaling in relief. Given what he did on an immortal day at Hampden in 2016, no Hibs supporter wanted to boo the man they called Sir David Gray, nobody wanted to call for his head. It was a painful endgame, for everybody.

Hibs have sacked many managers in recent seasons, but this was no Nick Montgomery, no Lee Johnson, no Shaun Maloney. Gray was altogether different. Driven, passionate, honest as the day is long, brutally so when talking about how things were going wrong, which he had been doing too much of lately.
points: A club hero, David Gray ends his time as Hibs head coach not to the sound of euphoria from fans, but to the sound of a support collectively exhaling in relief, writes Tom English.

articles.title: Saudi Pro League club Al-Taawoun handed stadium ban over Diogo Jota chants
articles.summary: Fans heard shouting chants of ‘Jota’ against Al-Hilal. Ronaldo had called for lifetime bans for those supporters. The Saudi Pro League club Al-Taawoun have been fined nearly £20,000 and given a two-game stadium ban after fans chanted about the late Liverpool and Portugal forward Diogo Jota.
body: The Al-Hilal midfielder Rúben Neves, who played with Jota for Wolves and Portugal, was shown gesturing to the sky after audible chants of “Jota” from Al-Taawoun fans could be heard during Saturday’s league game.
Jota died in July 2025 along with his brother, André ‌Silva, in a car crash in Spain and Neves was one of the pallbearers at his funeral.

A statement from the Saudi Football Federation read: “The fans of Al-Taawoun chanted phrases and slogans that violated the provisions of the disciplinary and ethics regulations, and the committee decided to increase the penalty in accordance with (39-4) of the disciplinary and ethics regulations.”
The federation ordered Al-Taawoun to play their next two home league matches behind closed doors and fined the club 100,000 riyals (£19,800).

articles.title: ‘My scar, not your scar’: Tuchel stands by England semi-final subs but admits wrong timing
articles.summary: Coach says Argentina’s gung-ho approach forced hand. ‘No one is more hurt than me, no one wanted it more’ Thomas Tuchel stands by his heavily criticised defensive substitutions in the World Cup semi-final defeat against Argentina this summer, but the England head coach accepts he made them too…
body: Tuchel said England were “waiting for death”, unable to cope with the attacking tactics adopted by Argentina in Atlanta as they chased the game after Anthony Gordon’s opener on the hour. He said fatigue and the success of defending with a back five in knockout games against Mexico and Norway also influenced his decisions to sit on the lead.
That approach proved catastrophic as goals from Enzo Fernández and Lautaro Martínez in the final stages of the game ended England’s dreams of making a first World Cup final since 1966.

“You can try to kill me here. But it’s my scar, it’s not your scar,” Tuchel said in a documentary on the England app. “No one is more hurt than me, no one wanted it more. They can endlessly torture you and think: ‘If I had done different substitutions, then we would have won the match.’ You just don’t know it.

articles.title: Leicestershire on brink of relegation after 27-point deduction
articles.summary: Leicestershire are on the brink of relegation from County Championship Division One after being deducted 27 points for breaching pitch regulations.
body: The points penalty imposed by the independent Cricket Discipline Panel (CDP) midway through their penultimate match of the season meant the Foxes have dropped to the bottom of the table.

In his interview with the Cricket Regulator before the tribunal hearing, Leicestershire's head groundsman Callum Lewin said there were "circumstances leading up to the game that were just out of my control".

They included an "unscheduled Bollywood filming event" taking place at Uptonsteel Grace Road four days before the start of the match, while Lewin also referenced the exceptionally hot weather in the build-up as another possible reason for the pitch being dry.

Leicestershire's punishment consists of the loss of all 19 points earned in the win over Glamorgan, an extra eight-point penalty and a £5,000 fine. A further eight-point deduction has been suspended for a year.

articles.title: Why UTSA coach Jeff Traylor is ready to get away from matchups like No. 1 Texas
articles.summary: The gap between the college football elite and programs like UTSA has only grown since the Roadrunners first delivered a scare to the Longhorns in 2022.
body: Days before leading UTSA into Austin for the program's first matchup against Texas in 2022, coach Jeff Traylor talked about doing away with the Power Five and Group of Five monikers.

Fans want more matchups between great programs, and the labels only reinforced a divide that didn't need to exist. UTSA entered the game as less than a two-touchdown underdog facing a Texas program coming off a 20-19 home loss to No. 1 Alabama. Appalachian State's 17-14 win at No. 6 Texas A&M the same day only added more fuel.
"Last weekend was good for all of college football," Traylor said, "and it gives the Roadrunners hope."

UTSA played like it, dialing up a surprise onside kick and then a trick play for a touchdown to take a 10-point lead early in the second quarter, providing a real scare before Texas surged to win 41-20.

articles.title: 'It's a miracle' - fireball crash victim Millroy praises rescuer Hartog
articles.summary: British racing driver Ollie Millroy says it is a "miracle I'm alive" after fellow driver Loek Hartog "did everything right" when saving him from his blazing car.
body: Millroy, 36, was hit by two other cars during the China GT Championship race at the Shanghai International Circuit 11 days ago, with his Ferrari immediately catching fire before hitting the safety barriers.
A barely conscious Millroy was stuck in his car for over a minute before he was pulled from the burning wreckage by Dutchman Hartog after he immediately stopped his car to help him.
"He acted instantly and he did everything right," a recovering Millroy told BBC Sport from his hospital bed in China.
"Watching the video back, it looks like you're watching a movie and everything's rehearsed.

articles.summary: Max Verstappen stormed from the back of a 101-kart grid to win a frantic race at Silverstone in blistering time. The four-time world champion needed just 14 laps - 37 minutes - to overtake 100 karts driven by content creators, athletes and general motorsport fans as part of the Red Bull-run ‘Max vs…
body: It took place on a purpose-built track at Silverstone, incorporating its kart venue with some of the grand prix circuit like Brooklands and a lap time was roughly two minutes aboard a go-kart.
Verstappen had the task of starting at the back of the grid and overtaking all 100 competitors within 30 tours and the moment an amateur was passed, they were eliminated.
All drivers were given identical karts but the amateurs also had the advantage of utilising a ‘fast lap’ in the opening half of the race, where they could take a short cut to pull further clear.

Yet it very quickly became evident that Verstappen would have no difficulty in completing the challenge, after incredibly overtaking 64 karts on a first lap where he displayed his professional driver abilities to weave through the carnage.

articles.title: Leicestershire hit with 27-point deduction for breaching pitch regulations
articles.summary: Leicestershire County Cricket Club have been deducted 27 points and fined £5,000 for breaching pitch regulations in their victory over Glamorgan in August.
body: In a statement on Wednesday, the club said: "The Club notes the Cricket Discipline Panel's decision, which imposes an eight-point deduction, an additional eight-point deduction suspended until the end of the 2027 season, and a financial penalty of £5000.
"Under ECB Rothesay County Championship Playing Condition 16.2.6, the 19 points earned in the match concerned will also be deducted from Leicestershire CCC's 2026 Rothesay County Championship total.
"Having received the Panel's decision, the Club is reviewing its position and considering all available options. No further statement will be issued at this time."

The independent Cricket Discipline Panel (CDP) upheld the Cricket Regulator's charge against Leicestershire for breaching the ECB Pitch Regulations, with the pitch at Uptonsteel Grace Road rated as 'poor' during the County Championship match against Glamorgan, between August 20-23.

articles.title: L.A. Queens vs. San Francisco Firebells — WPBL Championship discussion thread
articles.summary: And then there were two. The inaugural season of the Women’s Professional Baseball League has arrived at the championship series: The No. 3 Los Angeles Queens vs. the No. 1 San Francisco Firebells. Game 1 of the best-of-five series takes place tonight.
body: “The WPBL’s Championship Series represents a monumental milestone for women’s professional baseball,” said WPBL commissioner Justine Seigal said in a press release. “The Firebells and the Queens have shown incredible skill, resilience, and sportsmanship all season. Fans are in for an unforgettable series as these two incredible teams compete for the championship trophy.”

The Firebells swept the Boston Hunters 2-0 in their semifinals, which concluded on Sept. 11, while the Queens squeaked out a 15-11 Game 3 victory over the New York Heights on Monday. San Francisco won the regular-season series against L.A. 3-2.

For fans of “A League of Our Own,” actress Megan Cavanagh, who played Marla Houch in the 1992 classic film, will be attending Game 1. WPBL will be hosting a FanFest before the game to kick off the first title series in style.
How to Watch: Those in the United States can watch on ESPN Select. International viewers can find the game on the WPBL YouTube Channel.

articles.title: Horror own goal sees Fleetwood shock Sheff Utd and book Arsenal tie
articles.summary: Rhys Norrington-Davies' horror own goal sent Fleetwood into the last 16 of the Carabao Cup for the first time as the League Two side stunned Championship Sheffield United 1-0 at Highbury.
body: Norrington-Davies nodded a Danny Andrew cross into his own net from close range in the 57th minute to earn Fleetwood a bumper home draw against Arsenal.
Matt Lawlor's side, unbeaten now in nine games in all competitions, had another Andrew effort ruled out for offside and twice hit the woodwork in a dominant second-half display.

Tom Cannon did put the ball in the net for Chris Wilder's visitors, who lined up with only four starting survivors from last Friday's 1-0 league defeat by Wolves, but an offside flag was raised before the striker slid the ball into the net.
United had started positively and Ollie Arblaster had a goalbound effort blocked after only 36 seconds.

articles.title: Man Utd collapse from 2-0 up to exit Carabao Cup to Brighton
articles.summary: Manchester United hit a new low under Michael Carrick as they threw away a two-goal lead to lose 3-2 to Brighton - and exit the Carabao Cup at the first hurdle for a second straight year.
body: It is the first time in 50 years that United have held a 2-0 lead at Old Trafford and lost the game. They had won 143 out of the 145 previous times they had raced into such an advantage.
Yet it was all going to plan for Carrick's side as they looked to respond to the Manchester derby defeat, as talented teen Shea Lacey and Mason Mount put them in control after 10 minutes.
But United began sleepwalking towards defeat - failing to register another shot on target until the 76th minute - and Brighton, who made six changes for this cup tie, took advantage.

After Charalampos Kostoulas pulled one back on the stroke of half-time after questionable goalkeeping from Karl Darlow, the Seagulls struck twice in four second-half minutes through Pascal Gross and substitute Maxim De Cuyper to stun Old Trafford into silence.
